Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Den Haag Zuidwest, named by CBS alongside Moerwijk and Bouwlust en Vrederust as scoring unfavourably against the rest of the city on crime as well as on poverty and welfare dependency. The Hague's own figures are published per wijk through Den Haag in Cijfers and the national Veiligheidsmonitor, a population survey run for CBS and the Ministry of Justice and Security. Post-war residential, a long way from the centre and the sea.

Frequently asked questions

Is Morgenstond safe?

Wandroz currently rates Morgenstond in The Hague as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in The Hague during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in The Hague at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. The Hague publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Morgenstond safe at night?

At night, Morgenstond is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in The Hague. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Morgenstond a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Morgenstond's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in The Hague) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Morgenstond?

Not an official government crime feed — Morgenstond's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used). An absence of recent negative coverage is treated as inconclusive, not as proof the area is safe. If you live in or know Morgenstond well, you can suggest a correction using the link below.
